messages:
Harper (People Ops): Need to add my registered domestic partner to benefits after we filed paperwork in CA. We registered last week. Can I add them midyear for medical/dental/vision and FSA elections? What docs do you need?
Mina (Benefits): Congrats! Domestic partnership registrations usually qualify as a QLE. You have 30 days from registration to submit for midyear enrollment. Docs we typically need: partnership registration, government ID for partner (driver's license or passport), proof of shared residence (lease or utility bill) and SSN/ITIN for medical.
Harper (People Ops): Partner is a US citizen with SSN. We have the registration and joint lease. Do I need to change FSA election midyear?
Mina (Benefits): For HCFSA/DCFSA, you can change elections midyear only for a qualifying life event that affects eligibility. Adding a dependent that changes coverage consistent with a QLE usually allows election change. We'll need you to confirm the requested FSA election amount change in the submission.
Owen (Payroll): Note: premiums and pre-tax elections will be prorated for the pay period when coverage becomes effective. If you increase FSA deferral, payroll will update contributions starting the next payroll after the effective date.
Harper (People Ops): Is there a secure way to submit docs? Also concerned about domestic partner tax implications (imputed income).
Mina (Benefits): Use the internal secure portal: https://hr.redwood.com/secure-upload. For subject line use: "QLE - Add domestic partner - Harper". Regarding taxes: if partner is not a tax dependent, medical premium value may be treated as imputed income; Benefits team flags the case and Tax/Payroll will calculate. We'll include an imputed income estimate when we submit to carriers.
BenefitsBot: Carrier turnaround for QLE submissions: ~7-14 business days. Tax impact notice will be sent separately if imputed income applies.
Harper (People Ops): Great — uploading now. Also, do we need to update beneficiary designations now that partner is added?
Mina (Benefits): Good call. Enrollment won't change retirement beneficiaries automatically. Update 401(k)/Equity beneficiary forms in People Portal if you want partner named. We can include a reminder in the confirmation email after carrier processes the enrollment.
Harper (People Ops): Thanks! Uploading docs and will note FSA election change requested.
Owen (Payroll): I'll watch for the carrier effective date and coordinate the payroll proration. :+1:
